budget_source.rule: N03 development total at most 24 attempted episodes including N02; incompatible historical attempts remain counted

defined_denominator: Distinct real task episode with >=1 request_start, counted once per run/episode/arm; repeated J/action calls within same episode are calls, not extra episodes; imported shared source counted once in parent_source run.
global_unlogged_upper_bound: UNKNOWN; this census cannot bound unlogged external calls
reasoning: N02 4 + PIPE3 smoke 6 + C1 bounded live v2-v4 15 = 25 certain attempts, already above 24. Neutral-preparation 2 and parent-source/three-target 4 additional documented attempts bring the audited total to 31. Exact same request bodies across versions are not duplicate calls when request_start timestamps and run paths differ. Parent-source projection copies in arm logs have no source request_start and are not recounted.
qualification_limits: COMPLETE means the episode execution reached its recorded terminal path, not PASS quality or valid learning.
UNKNOWN includes real transport failures and downstream scoring/parse failures; no failed attempt is erased.
N02 provider health probes are real API diagnostics without task episodes and excluded from the episode cap.
Zero-call C1 fixtures and startup failure are not real task attempts.
This is a budget audit, not a new experiment or statistical estimate.
